relationships.subject: SNX25
relationships.evidence_quote: We confirmed that the tissue content of NGF was lower in Snx25 mcKO mice than in wild-type mice

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Snx25+/- mice (Fig. 7a-b and Supplementary Fig. 6a) as well as Snx25 mcKO mice (Fig. 7c-d) became sensitive to innocuous stimuli 24 h after NGF injection

relationships.subject: dermal macrophages
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP-positive C-nociceptors (possibly also TH-positive C-LTMRs) associated dermal macrophages control tactile perception by producing NGF and secreting it into the dermis

relationships.subject: NGF
relationships.evidence_quote: the expression of mechanosensory factors (Trpv1, Trpa1, and Trpc1) in the DRG was also found to increase at 20 h after intradermal injection of NGF

relationships.subject: SNX25
relationships.evidence_quote: We detected reduced mRNA levels of mechanosensory factors including Trpv2, Trpc1, and Scn10a in Snx25+/- DRGs

key_findings: Snx25+/- and macrophage-specific Snx25 cKO mice show reduced tactile sensitivity, mainly affecting C-fiber responses (5 Hz)
Dermal NGF injection restored tactile sensitivity; CX3CR1+ dermal macrophages sit near CGRP+ nerves and produce NGF
